# Output Standard Entity Sample

> **TL;DR:** This entity names the ingest output standard v2 marker.

## Overview

This entity names the ingest output standard v2 marker.

The marker is the frontmatter key output_standard with value v2.

## Details

Use the marker on new typed pages from skillwiki ingest.

The CLI stamps the marker on every new ingest stub.
